name: bottle_candidates_are_its_window_offer
description: A rival's corked bottle shows its tier and its candidates, the packs its window offered at that tier, never which one (contract-m8 §4, design 1.4): SimUndertow.candidates reads the Drift every client holds, not the commitment. Undertow on two clients fed one turn log: in window 2 seat 1 corks the Moth Cloud with a salt of its own. On both clients SimMatch.bottles(1) gives the corked bottle's candidates, the window's three offered packs in CHECK_IDS order, the same as drift_offer() and on each client alike, and no pack; the record's pack is -1 on both. Once the reveal names it, the bottle shows its pack and no candidates; seat 2's bottle, corked in the same window and never uncorked, shows none once it has fizzled.

steps.assert: offer.size() == 3 and offer == scene.client(2).drift_offer() and not offer.has('swift')
steps.msg: seed 1's window 2 offers three packs, the same on both clients

steps.assert: shown[0].size() == 1 and shown[0][0]['candidates'] == offer and shown[1][0]['candidates'] == offer and shown[0] == shown[1]
steps.msg: the corked bottle's candidates are its window's offer, alike on both clients

steps.assert: not shown[0][0].has('pack') and not shown[1][0].has('pack') and scene.client(1).bottle_list[0].pack == -1 and scene.client(2).bottle_list[0].pack == -1

steps.msg: SimUndertow.candidates the same, and seat 2's bottle of the same window the same

steps.assert: opened[0]['pack'] == 'winged' and opened[1]['pack'] == 'winged' and not opened[0].has('candidates') and scene.candidates_of(1) == [[]]
steps.msg: uncorked, the bottle shows its pack and no candidates

steps.assert: scene.client(1).bottles(2)[0]['fizzled'] and not scene.client(1).bottles(2)[0].has('candidates') and not scene.client(1).bottles(2)[0].has('pack') and scene.hashes_agree()
steps.msg: seat 2's bottle fizzled: neither candidates nor a pack; the clients agree throughout
